name: hypermcp
description: A local MCP runtime with tool discovery, reference data, schema locks, secret scrubbing, and staged writes.

scripts.build: node scripts/clean-dist.js && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/copy-dashboard.js
scripts.test: node --experimental-sqlite --import tsx --test tests/e2e.test.ts tests/dashboard.test.ts tests/security.test.ts tests/cli.test.ts tests/stagingJournal.test.ts tests/sqliteOcc.test.ts
